meta.name: tps-roster
meta.description: tps roster — read-only org chart. Reads ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json as metadata (the base profile denies it to agents; this operator-side profile exempts it explicitly) and nothing else. No writes, no network. Linux note: Landlock cannot express deny-within-allow, so a deny nested inside an allowed parent makes nono refuse to start (it will not silently weaken the deny) — keep every deny at or above the allow roots. Matters for the exe.dev profiles (ops-mxf9). Never grant the state root: ~/.tps/secrets and ~/.tps/identity are siblings of the mailbox and agent state, so a grant or deny at ~/.tps level takes the mailbox and agent state with it.
